iphone_steps: Connect iPhone to any internet (Wi-Fi or cellular).
Verify HTTPS loads and certificate is valid.
Tap Share → Add to Home Screen → confirm name → Add.
Launch the PIA icon from Home Screen — opens in standalone installed PWA mode.
Repeat validations in both Safari browser and installed PWA.
risks: Random hostname changes per session unless a named tunnel is configured.
Free tier has no custom headers; if API requires Host validation, use --http-host-header localhost.
Quick-tunnel is best-effort, not for production.

iphone_steps: Ensure iPhone is signed into the same Tailscale network.
limitations: HTTP only — Safari will warn for non-HTTPS.
Service worker registration requires secure context — installed-PWA mode will NOT register the SW on http://.
Use only for Safari browser validation, not installed-PWA validation.
